description: South African public school calendar: term dates and school holidays for 2026 and 2027 from the Department of Basic Education, special school holidays, and whether a given date is a school day. Useful for family travel, childcare, events and education planning in South Africa. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).
